title: process source base schema
description: Fields common to every material source. The identifier is what a step's setpoints point at, so a step can say which source it is pulsing without repeating the source itself.

id.description: Identifier for this source within the stage, referenced from a step's setpoints.

formula.description: Chemical formula of the source material, e.g. Al(CH3)3

_material.description: Subset of the full information about the material this source is made of.
